open_findings.title: Require a live immediate freeze reservation for backup capability admission and use
open_findings.contract: SQLITE-OWNERSHIP-PROPOSAL.md:274-285 requires lifecycle lock, guard, validated BEGIN IMMEDIATE freeze, separate source/destination, and retention of freeze across backup/file/fingerprint phases.
open_findings.evidence: Valid immediate control blocks another process write reservation. Before BEGIN, after commit, after rollback, or after deferred BEGIN, backup-source is admitted while a real second process can acquire BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Standalone source/destination are admitted with no freeze parent and destination creates a file. After entering correct freeze/source/destination then rolling back the parent, backup_to succeeds and produces 77824 bytes while another process can reserve writes.
open_findings.impact: Internal backup capabilities can be used without the approved frozen consistency boundary. Normal checkpoint currently follows the correct sequence; this is not evidence that the ordinary checkpoint path omits its freeze or that a remote caller can invoke this surface.
open_findings.required_change: Require an active validated same-root/same-guard BEGIN IMMEDIATE freeze parent at backup admission and use. Restrict reservation roles from deferred BEGIN, refuse commit or permanently end reservation capability, and invalidate reservation use after public rollback while preserving cleanup/error handling. Reject standalone source/destination before any file creation.
